map.25–30cm 为轻度增多，>30cm 为羊水过多，需排查妊娠期糖尿病、胎儿消化: 25–30 cm indicates a mild increase and >30 cm polyhydramnios, requiring checks for gestational diabetes, fetal gastrointestinal malformation or chromosomal abnormalities, though a mild increase alone can also occur in a normal pregnancy.

map.AFI 是四象限之和，对羊水偏少更敏感；SDP 看最大单一暗区。一般 AFI<5: AFI is the sum of the four quadrants and is more sensitive to low amniotic fluid; SDP looks at the single largest dark area. Generally AFI<5 cm or SDP<2 cm is judged as oligohydramnios, and the clinical diagnosis often combines both.

map.妊娠期糖尿病或胎儿畸形排查时，监测 AFI 排除羊水过多。: When screening for gestational diabetes or fetal malformation, monitor the AFI to exclude polyhydramnios.
map.孕晚期超声测四个象限羊水最大暗区，求和得 AFI，判断羊水量是否过少或过多。: In the late trimester, ultrasound measures the largest dark area in each of the four quadrants and their sum gives the AFI, which judges whether the amniotic fluid volume is too low or too high.
map.怀疑胎膜早破或胎儿生长受限时，用 AFI 快速筛查羊水过少。: When premature rupture of membranes or restricted fetal growth is suspected, use the AFI for a quick screen for oligohydramnios.
map.羊水指数(AFI)正常范围评估器 使用指南: Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI) Normal Range Evaluator Guide
map.羊水指数按四象限深度求和；AFI 5–24 cm 为正常，24 cm 羊水过多；: The amniotic fluid index sums the depths of the four quadrants; an AFI of 5–24 cm is normal, above 24 cm is polyhydramnios; an SDP of 2–8 cm is normal.
map.输入四个象限最大羊水池垂直深度，求和得羊水指数 AFI 并对照正常范围，判断羊水: Enter the maximum vertical depth of the amniotic pocket in each of the four quadrants and sum them to get the AFI, then compare against the normal range to judge oligohydramnios or polyhydramnios. It is used in prenatal ultrasound assessment of the intrauterine environment and placental function.
